correctness.rationale: Complete-pair Gini of a real vector is exactly reducible to binary cuts for a constant-preserving linear Markov operator. Under K_{m,m} half-lazy transition, a cut with r sites in the first part, s in the second, k=r+s and d=|r-s| has exact output Gini mk-r²-s²+d[rs+(m-r)(m-s)]/(2m), obtained by counting within- and between-class output levels. The normalized expression R=1/2+d[m²+(m-k)²-2md-d²]/[4mk(2m-k)] is maximized by a singleton (or complement), using complement symmetry, d<=k, d>=1 and convex endpoint comparison in t=m-k, yielding 3(m-1)/[2(2m-1)]. At m=1 the walk is uniform averaging and norm zero. Strict equality in the cuts plus nesting of level sets proves only one-exception-coordinate real extremizers for m>=3, and rational comparison proves monotone rise to unattained 3/4.
